verdict.rationale: Empresa Online is a one-off government company-incorporation service (form, digital signature, payment, registration), so a user-defined event-driven automation rules engine is outside this product type's axis. The evidence shows only system-initiated notifications and emails, such as correction notices and the registration-complete email, not user-configurable rules or triggers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events
